authority_scope_handling.problem: The canonical AT07 query authority is explicitly scoped to exactly one universe ref, so the changed-source universe was refused with Pre553AuthorityError('exact authority scope does not include source_universe_refs') -> typed UNAVAILABLE / MISSING_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY rather than silently coerced.
authority_scope_handling.resolution: The fixture builds a changed-source query authority whose explicit scope names the changed universe (frozen_changed_source_query_authority), copying the canonical governed semantics and replacing only the explicit universe scope, with the authority content hash rebound to the new material.
authority_scope_handling.note: This is a fixture-only authority construction. It does not alter provider behaviour, owner law, or the canonical AT07 authority.
